# Competitor Report: Evening and weekend dance classes (Bollywood, hip-hop, dance fitness), Chennai

**Target customer:** Working professionals, age 22 to 40

The strongest starting offer is a simple evening and weekend dance class package for working professionals in Chennai, with Bollywood, hip-hop, and dance fitness in one easy-to-join format. Competitors already offer adult classes, so the gap is not the dance styles themselves but a clearer promise, fixed timings after work, and a smoother sign-up path that feels made for busy adults.

## 1. Key Competitors

| Competitor | Area | Price | Schedule | Google rating | Channels |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| The Swingers Dance | T. Nagar, Chennai | Rs 2,999 other [1] | Classes twice a week for one hour, available on weekdays and weekends | 4.7 (241) [2] | website, WhatsApp, phone, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, walk-in |
| Dance and Dance Studio | Anna Salai / Greams Road, Chennai | Rs 150 per class [3] | Bollywood regular classes Mon & Wed 6:00 PM to 7:00 PM; weekend classe | 4.3 (40) [4] | website, phone, email, walk-in |
| Raack | Velachery, Chennai | on enquiry | Dance Fitness shown at 7:00 PM - 8:00 PM on weekdays and 10:30 AM - 11 | 4.8 (616) [5] | website, phone, email, walk-in |
| The Life of Dance Academy | unknown | not found | Flexible weekday and weekend batches | - | website |

2 of 4 competitors publish a price; the rest share fees only on enquiry.

> **Note:** fewer than 3 competitors in Chennai publish prices online, so price comparisons rest on 2 businesses. Hidden prices are themselves a gap: an openly priced offer stands out.

## 2. What Customers Complain About

- **The Swingers Dance:** Phone calls go unanswered. *"No response for phone calls"* [2]
- **The Swingers Dance:** Staff were seen as rude about fees and show charges. *"she told "you can discontinue the class, we don't have any problem."* [2]
- **The Swingers Dance:** Some customers felt teaching quality dropped over time. *"Now a days no improvements, masters r changed quality changed."* [2]
- **Dance and Dance Studio:** One reviewer said the studio felt dirty and staff were rude. *"Dingy studio and ill mannered staff. Strictly avoid."* [4]
- **Raack:** Some parents felt the administration and environment were poor. *"the administration and the environment created in that place is not so great."* [5]

## 3. Market Gap

The clearest gap is a simple, transparent adult package for working professionals that combines evening and weekend timing with a clear published price. Competitors either publish class prices that are structured as workshop blocks or short packages, or they have adult-friendly schedules but no public price; none of them clearly own an easy, low-friction monthly offer for 22 to 40 year olds.

*Evidence: The Swingers Dance, Dance and Dance Studio, Raack, The Life of Dance Academy.*

## 4. Recommended Positioning

> **Evening + weekend Bollywood, hip-hop & dance fitness for working professionals — ₹1999/month**

**Launch price:** Rs 1,999 per month. This sits below The Swingers Dance’s ₹2999 for 2 months and ₹3999 for 3 months, and below Dance and Dance Studio’s ₹1500 for 8 hours or ₹150 per class when converted into a monthly commitment. It also gives a clearer monthly offer than Raack and The Life of Dance Academy, which show adult schedules but no published price.

## 5. 30-Day Launch Plan

**Week 1: Set up the offer and collect first interest**
- Write one simple offer sheet with class days, time slots, styles, and who it is for.
- Create a WhatsApp message and a short enquiry form so every lead gets the same reply.
- Visit 3 office areas, co-working spaces, or office-adjacent cafes and share the offer with working adults.
- Collect at least 15 names and phone numbers from people who say they may join.

**Week 2: Run trial classes and learn what people want**
- Run 2 trial classes, one on a weekday evening and one on a weekend.
- Include short sections of Bollywood, hip-hop, and dance fitness in each trial.
- Ask each attendee which style they liked best and which timing works for them.
- Write down the most common reasons people say yes or no.

**Week 3: Adjust the offer and try to convert interest**
- Change the class timing or format based on trial feedback.
- Message every trial attendee on WhatsApp and invite them to join the main class package.
- Post short clips from the trial classes on Instagram and in local WhatsApp groups.
- Follow up with people who did not join and ask what stopped them.

**Week 4: Test the best version and decide the next step**
- Run 2 more classes in the time slots that got the best response.
- Ask new joiners for a short review after class.
- Track how many people enquired, attended, and paid.
- Decide whether to keep, improve, or stop the offer based on repeat interest and paid sign-ups.

The Swingers Dance Studio, 3rd Floor, No: 101/102, New Avadi Rd, Kilpauk Garden Colony, Kilpauk, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600010, India: 4.7 stars from 241 Google ratings

5 stars, a week ago: We had a wonderful experience at Swingers Dance Class today!

I took my toddler along while accompanying his sister to her dance class, and Master Rahul went above and beyond to make him feel included. He warmly invited my little one to join the group, made him feel comfortable, and patiently taught him dance throughout the entire session.

What truly stood out was his exceptional ability to connect with children. His patience, kindness, enthusiasm, and natural way of handling little ones are simply outstanding. He doesn’t just teach dance; he makes every child feel welcomed, encouraged, and confident enough to participate.

Tutors like Rahul are rare, and we genuinely need more passionate and child-friendly teachers like him. His dedication and positive attitude made the experience truly special for us.

A big shout-out to Master Rahul and the entire team! I would wholeheartedly recommend Swingers Dance Class to anyone looking for a wonderful learning environment for their children.

The best, hands down! 100% recommended!

trail.claim: Staff were seen as rude about fees and show charges
trail.excerpt:
1 stars, 2 years ago: Such a bad experience with your institution. When Iam taking admission for my kid Receptionist Ms. Bavithra told we have two shows during the course time. Interested students should pay the fees for costumes otherwise there is no hidden charge/training charge/auditorium fee for the programme ( I have asked the same question again and again because I know that very well they will confuse the customer for getting admission). I have paid three months fees together. Yesterday my kid got a circular that they are going to do an inspirational show and parents should pay for the entry ticket if they want to see the programme.

When Iam asking this to Ms. Bavithra, she is replying very arrogantly. She told we will change our proceedures as per our wish. I have asked why don't you give complimentary pass atleast for parents, she told "you can discontinue the class, we don't have any problem. As a classical dancer, as a performer, as a trainer this is not an issue of ticket price for me, this is absolutely hiding the details and canvasing the customer. After paying fees their real face will reveal. I don't know whether it is a plan of owner or Receptionist Ms Bavithra's marketing technique.

Dance and Dance Academy, 714 Pathari Road, Anna Salai, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600006, India: 4.3 stars from 40 Google ratings

5 stars, 11 months ago: Attending Dance and Dance Academy has honestly been one of the best decisions I’ve ever made. I still remember my first day—walking in a little nervous—and being greeted with such warmth that I immediately felt at ease. The instructors at Dance and Dance Academy are truly something special. They’re not just talented dancers; they’re patient, encouraging, and genuinely invested in helping each student grow at their own pace.

Classes strike the perfect balance between challenging and fun. I always leave feeling accomplished, even on days when I’m convinced I’m off-beat. The teachers know exactly how to push you without ever making you feel overwhelmed. Because of them, I’ve seen real progress—not only in my technique, but also in my confidence and joy for dance.

What surprised me the most is the sense of community. Everyone cheers each other on, laughs together, and celebrates every small win. It’s such a supportive, uplifting environment that it’s easy to stay motivated.

The studio itself is clean, bright, and welcoming, making it a place I genuinely look forward to returning to. I’m truly grateful for everything I’ve experienced at Dance and Dance Academy, and I’d recommend it to anyone wanting to grow, feel inspired, and enjoy their dance journey.

5 stars, 5 months ago: I have had a wonderful experience with Raack Academy in Velachery. The academy provides a positive and energetic environment where students of all age groups can learn and grow confidently. The instructors are highly skilled, patient, and dedicated to helping every student improve their dance techniques and stage presence.

The management team is well-organized, responsive, and professional. Class schedules, events, performances, and communications are handled efficiently, making the entire learning experience smooth for both students and parents. Any queries are addressed promptly, and the staff ensure that students feel welcomed and supported throughout their journey.
The academy has built a strong reputation for quality dance training, structured programs, and regular performance opportunities. It also maintains strong public ratings and reviews from a large number of students, reflecting consistent customer satisfaction.

Overall, Raack Academy of Dance, Velachery is an excellent choice for anyone looking to learn dance in a professional, friendly, and well-managed environment. I would highly recommend it to both beginners and advanced dancers.

trail.claim: Some parents felt the administration and environment were poor
trail.excerpt: 1 stars, a year ago: These words are based on my own experience. We joined our kid in this branch of dance school 8 months ago. Though the masters are good, the administration and the environment created in that place is not so great. In the particular batch which my kid was assigned had worst groupism which didn't stop with the kids but the parents too were dominating. The whole group of kids won't speak with newly joined kids and they don't allow them to stand in the front row to dance even if my kid go as a first person to the class. The master keep ignoring the complaint from my kid. The mothers of those kids who stay till the class duration consider that place like some ladies club and have fun shouting laughing and disturbing the practicing kids. The receptionist or the admin joins the fun club without any etiquette. This bias towards the longer tenure kids didn't just stop with the practice. They conducted an event in a mall where only those dignified group of parents only were allowed to stay close to their kids while we were forced to go out of dancing area by some bouncers. Those parents were not even volunteers and they had chance to see their kids performance very near them while we had to watch from first floor or second floor of the mall just like other visitors to the mall. This unbiased and dominating nature might not be there in other centres or batch timings and like I said it's purely based on my experience. My kid stopped dancing as she felt hurt with the continuous domination around and the ignorance of the master and the administration.
